entry.name: jit.ayuv2argb
entry.description: Converts 4-plane char AYUV (alpha, luminance, signed chroma blue, signed chroma red) matrix into a 4-plane char ARGB (alpha, red, green, blue) matrix. Unlike UYVY data, AYUV data has an alpha channel and full resolution chroma data.
